name: tracker-follow-through-shpe9k
goal: Replay item chasing, unattended work admission, and unanswered asks through the native Tracker lifecycle

evidence: The native CLI must persist chase history across sync and finish, keep capacity-held work queued, and ask again on the Lisbon schedule.
Existing CLI replay lacked chase and completion assertions, host-capacity fixture only used prequeued items, and direct-reminder fixture tested hourly retries.

Committed 4d74b5e18e reproduced unavailable chase, missing queued idle work, and the earlier reminder interval in the same three frozen test files. Signed MB2 replay also rejected the chase command at the red checkpoint.
Synced journal chase events, dispatcher admission for idle work, and durable Lisbon follow-ups use existing Tracker boundaries.
Frozen corpus failed at 3027531294 and passed at c2cd0bc4ea. Exact native CLI and tmux replay on harbor-mbp-2 passed eight tests.
